mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_track (trip_id, lat, lng, accuracy) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{accuracy})
mapper.select: SELECT lat, lng FROM trip_track WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND (accuracy IS NULL OR accuracy <= #{maxAccuracy}) AND recorded_at >= NOW() - #{seconds} * INTERVAL '1 second' ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, track_id DESC LIMIT #{count}

SELECT s.stop_id AS stopId, ST_Distance(a.boundary, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography) AS meters FROM trip_stop s JOIN place_area a ON a.place_id = s.place_id OR REPLACE(a.name, ' ', '') = REPLACE(s.name, ' ', '') WHERE s.trip_id = #{tripId}

SELECT k.lat, k.lng, (k.recorded_at::date - t.start_date + 1) AS day, to_char(k.recorded_at, 'HH24:MI') AS time FROM trip_track k JOIN trip t ON t.trip_id = k.trip_id WHERE k.trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY k.recorded_at, k.track_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM trip_track WHERE trip_id IN (SELECT trip_id FROM trip WHERE member_id = #{memberId})
